audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED ABILITY NAME, repeated six times. The content layer credits 'Vicious Strikes' with Olaf's true damage AND his lifesteal, in whys[1], spikes[0].text, early, mid, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0]. Vicious Strikes is not in Olaf's kit. It is a pre-rework name that no longer maps to any slot.
audit.why: Olaf's live kit is Berserker Rage (P), Undertow (Q), Tough It Out (W), Reckless Swing (E), Ragnarok (R). The true damage is Reckless Swing (E) — 325 range, 11/10/9/8/7s, costs him health and refunds it on a kill. The lifesteal is Berserker Rage (P) and it scales with his MISSING health, which is the opposite of what a player assumes: he heals hardest at the moment you think you have him. Tough It Out (W) is attack speed plus a shield on 16/15/14/13/12s and was never mentioned at all.
audit.corrected: Every occurrence replaced with the correct ability, and the lifesteal moved from the invented W to Berserker Rage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ragnarok is described as 'Cleanses CC' in three places (breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t) and dontsFull[0].t is literally titled 'E-root during his R (cleansed)'. It does not cleanse, and the immunity is conditional.
audit.why: Riot's text: he passively gains armor and magic resist, and can activate to become immune to disables FOR AS LONG AS HE KEEPS ATTACKING. Two things follow that the page never told the reader: it does not remove CC already on him, and the immunity lapses the moment he stops swinging. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion and reports it replaced every cleanse claim on the Olaf page.
audit.corrected: All three cleanse claims replaced with the accurate immunity wording plus the attacking condition, and the don't retitled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard numbers on the page are wrong. content.late says Ragnarok has a '120-second cooldown at max rank'. And content.early tells the reader that at Level 2 'if he pops Ragnarok before you can root him your entire setup is negated' — Ragnarok is an ultimate and cannot exist before level 6.
audit.why: Ragnarok is 100/90/80s, so at max rank it is 80 seconds, not 120 — the page's 'clear windows every two minutes' advice is built on a number that is 50% too high and makes the reader wait through a window they already had. The level-2 claim invents a threat two levels before it exists, which teaches the wrong early-lane read.
audit.corrected: late corrected to 80s at max rank; early rewritten so level 2 is about Undertow's armour shred and Reckless Swing rather than a nonexistent ultimate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart rows 0, 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with the packet in both layers.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Olaf x6 then Swain. The mirror flipped exactly these four rows in matched pairs ('phases[0]/[3]/[4]/[6].side and win[0]/[3]/[4]/[6] flipped'). The prose already agreed: whys[0] says concede and farm at level 1, whys[3] and whys[4] describe Olaf owning 4-5 and 6, and whys[6]/spikes[3]/late all say two items is the first window that belongs to Swain. Rows 1, 2 and 5 already read Olaf and were left alone.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 flipped to Olaf and row 6 flipped to Swain, in both layers as one atomic group, ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undertow's cooldown reset was never mentioned, so the page's repeated 'kite his axes' advice has no actionable timing behind it.
audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s at every rank, but if Olaf picks the axe back up the cooldown RESETS. That is the whole punish: the axe on the ground is the timer, and denying him the pickup path is worth more than dodging the throw.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now states the shred, the slow and the reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tough It Out was absent from the entire page despite being the shield that eats Swain's burst opener.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule shield-absorbs-burst; the shield is on 16/15/14/13/12s, a shorter cycle than Nevermove, so it is available for most of Swain's commits unless it is forced out first.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now names it with its cooldown.

edits.before: At level 1 Olaf wins every trade outright — his Berserker passive attacks faster the lower his health goes, and you have no root yet to stop him closing distance. Stay at max Q range, collect free poke if he misses Undertow axes, and do not fight him. Level 2 changes nothing meaningful: even with E, if he pops Ragnarok before you can root him your entire setup is negated and he runs you down with true-damage Vicious Strikes. The only early trade worth taking is a clean E-root when Ragnarok is genuinely on cooldown and he is not at low HP (where Berserker stacks become dangerous). Otherwise bank the lane on distance and W harassment.
edits.after: At level 1 Olaf wins every trade outright — his Berserker Rage passive attacks faster and lifesteals harder the lower his health goes, and you have no root yet to stop him closing distance. Stay at max Q range, collect free poke if he misses Undertow axes, and do not fight him. Level 2 changes less than you would like: E gives you a root, but Undertow shreds your armour and slows you out of the pull, and Reckless Swing's true damage ignores everything you build. The only early trade worth taking is a clean E-root when he has thrown his axe and cannot pick it back up. Otherwise bank the lane on distance and W harassment.

edits.before: Level 6 does not flip the lane the way it does against most melee — Olaf's Ragnarok means he can activate CC immunity at will and walk through your Demonic Ascension drain while dealing true damage the entire time. Your R healing does not overcome his true damage throughput during Ragnarok, and the root that makes your R setup work is useless against him in that window. Play the Ragnarok timer: the cooldown is long, and if you can waste it with a fake engage or force it on a wave trade, the 15-20 seconds after it expires are your only genuine threat window. Anti-heal (Ignite, Morellonomicon rush) is mandatory — Vicious Strikes gives him serious lifesteal and he heals through your poke if you let him stack it.
edits.after: Level 6 does not flip the lane the way it does against most melee — Ragnarok makes him immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking, so he walks through your Demonic Ascension drain while Reckless Swing chips true damage. Your R healing does not overcome his throughput during Ragnarok, and the root that makes your R setup work does nothing in that window. Play the Ragnarok timer: it is 100 seconds at rank 1, and if you can waste it with a fake engage or force it on a wave trade, the stretch after it drops is your only genuine threat window. Anti-heal (Ignite, Morellonomicon rush) is mandatory — Berserker Rage gives him lifesteal that scales with his missing health, so he heals hardest exactly when you think you are winning.

edits.before: Two items in, your Liandry's burn stacking through W pokes and R drain finally makes the lane winnable in extended fights — Olaf's true damage is dangerous in short bursts but your heal rate at full build outpaces his DPS if you can delay the fight long enough. Track Ragnarok obsessively: 120-second cooldown at max rank means you get clear windows every two minutes where a full E-root-pull-Q-R combo can kill him or force a back. Never fight him in a side-lane alone when Ragnarok is up. Use Teleport and R AOE to dominate teamfights where he cannot Ragnarok five targets at once — your late game win condition is teamfight, not side-lane.
edits.after: Two items in, your Liandry's burn stacking through W pokes and R drain finally makes the lane winnable in extended fights — Olaf's true damage is dangerous in short bursts but your heal rate at full build outpaces his DPS if you can delay the fight long enough. Track Ragnarok obsessively: an 80-second cooldown at max rank means you get a clear window well inside every two minutes where a full E-root-pull-Q-R combo can kill him or force a back. Never fight him in a side-lane alone when Ragnarok is up. Use Teleport and R AOE to dominate teamfights where he cannot Ragnarok five targets at once — your late game win condition is teamfight, not side-lane.

notes: This was the worst page in my slice. A fabricated ability ('Vicious Strikes') carried the true damage AND the lifesteal across six fields, Ragnarok's cooldown was overstated by 50% in the advice the reader is told to time fights around, and content.early told the player to fear an ultimate at level 2. All three are now corrected. Two data issues for the user: (1) the brief's top-level games is 704 while packet.games is 148 for the same 46.62% figure — the same split I saw on swain__nasus, so the packet builder is reading two sources. (2) diffRating is '8.5/10', the only fractional rating I have seen in this champion's data; it renders fine but is inconsistent with every other page's whole-number scale.
